governing_statute.value: Fla. Stat. chapter 447, Part II (ss. 447.201-447.609), Public Employees
governing_statute.quote: Public employees shall have the right to form, join, and participate in, or to refrain from forming, joining, or participating in, any employee organization of their own choosing.

ulp_limitation_period.value: Six months from the alleged unfair labor practice to the filing of the charge, with an armed-forces service exception
ulp_limitation_period.quote: If the commission determines that the alleged unfair labor practice occurred more than 6 months prior to the filing of the charge, the commission shall issue an order dismissing the case

who_may_bargain.value: Any person employed by a public employer, except gubernatorial and elected appointees and the other exclusions listed in s. 447.203(16)
who_may_bargain.quote: “Public employee” means any person employed by a public employer except: (a) Those persons appointed by the Governor or elected by the people, agency heads, and members of boards and commissions. (b) Those persons holding positions by appointment or employment in the organized militia. (c) Those individuals acting as negotiating representatives for employer authorities. (d) Those persons who are designated by the commission as managerial or confidential employees pursuant to criteria contained herein. (e) Those persons holding positions of employment with the Florida Legislature. (f) Those persons who have been convicted of a crime and are inmates confined to institutions within the state. (g) Those persons appointed to inspection positions in federal/state fruit and vegetable inspection service whose conditions of appointment are affected by the following: 1. Federal license requirement. 2. Federal autonomy regarding investigation and disciplining of appointees. 3. Frequent transfers due to harvesting conditions. (h) Those persons employed by the Public Employees Relations Commission. (i) Those persons enrolled as undergraduate students in a state university who perform part-time work for the state university.

impasse_procedure.value: Either party declares impasse; optional mediation (none when the Governor is the employer); then a special magistrate appointed by PERC; the legislative body finally resolves the disputed issues after a public hearing
impasse_procedure.quote: the commission must appoint, and submit all unresolved issues to, a special magistrate acceptable to both parties.

strike_legality.value: Prohibited for public employees and employee organizations
strike_legality.quote: No public employee or employee organization may participate in a strike against a public employer by instigating or supporting, in any manner, a strike.

agency_fee_status.value: Not collectible from nonconsenting public employees under Janus v. AFSCME (2018). Florida also bars payroll dues deduction for most units (public safety and waivers excepted) and requires a signed membership authorization form.
agency_fee_status.quote: For these reasons, States and public-sector unions may no longer extract agency fees from nonconsenting employees.
agency_fee_status.pinpoint: Janus v. AFSCME, Council 31, 585 U.S. 878 (2018), Part VII
